chunks: And Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Harith, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام about water birds that eat fish, whether they are permissible. He said: "There is no harm in it; eat all of it."

key_terms.الْمَاءِ: water; here referring to aquatic or water-associated habitat
key_terms.كُلْهُ: all of it; eat it entirely
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; a formula indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: Are water birds that eat fish halal to eat in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling on the permissibility of eating water birds that feed on fish. Imam Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام states that there is no harm in eating them, indicating their halal status in this context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4148 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Harith who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan (as) about water birds that eat fish, whether they are permissible to eat.
He (as) said: "There is no harm in it, eat them."
